desc:
A size and fit helper for online stores asks a few quick questions and suggests the right option, with a short reason. Ecom Swift LLC builds it from your own size charts and measurements, so shoppers choose with more confidence and fewer avoidable returns.

## What is a size and fit helper?

A size and fit helper is a small tool on your product pages that guides a shopper to the size or model most likely to suit them. It might ask for height, usual size in another brand, or how the item will be used, then recommend an option and explain why.

It is more than a size chart. A chart gives the numbers and leaves the shopper to interpret them. A helper does the interpreting and gives a direct answer.

## Why wrong sizes hurt both shoppers and stores

When a shopper is not sure of the size, there are three outcomes. They buy two and return one, they guess and return the wrong one, or they do not buy at all. Each costs you: shipping both ways, handling time, restocking and sometimes a lost customer.

This applies beyond clothing. Shoes, rings, furniture, mattresses, helmets, cases and bike parts all have fit questions. Wherever "will it fit?" is the doubt, a helper can remove it.

## How fit guidance affects returns and conversions

The mechanism is certainty at the moment of choice. A recommendation with a reason, such as "this brand runs small, so most people in your range choose the next size up", turns a risky guess into a decision. Unsure shoppers who would have left may complete the purchase.

Returns can fall when fewer people order the wrong item, though results depend on your products, your sizing and how customers use the helper. In the higher package we also review your return reasons for fit patterns, so notes like "runs small" come from evidence. Fit varies between brands and bodies, so we add a plain reminder that the guidance is a suggestion, which keeps expectations honest.

## What a good size and fit helper includes

- Built from your own size chart and product measurements.
- A few simple questions, not a long form.
- A clear recommendation with a short reason.
- Fit notes such as runs small, true to size or roomy.
- Metric and imperial options.
- A link or button on every relevant product page.
- A layout that works on a phone without zooming.
- Separate guidance for each product group.
- A rewritten size guide page, where the package includes it.
- A review of return reasons to improve the notes.

## How we build it

We begin with your size charts and your product groups, because tops, shoes and accessories need different questions. If a chart is unclear or inconsistent, we point it out before building.

Then we write the questions and the logic, create the helper and place it on the product pages. We test it against a sample of real products and several body types, looking for cases where the advice sounds wrong. Basic covers one product group. Standard covers several groups with fit notes, unit options and a phone check. Premium covers more groups, return reason review, updated notes, a size guide rewrite and a period of adjustments.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Measure your products and share the true measurements.
- Mention when an item runs larger or smaller than expected.
- Keep the questions to what changes the answer.
- Review return reasons every few months and update notes.
- Tell shoppers how to measure themselves with a simple example.

**Avoid:**
- Copying a supplier size chart without checking it.
- Asking for sensitive body details that you do not need.
- Presenting a recommendation as a certainty.
- Using the same helper for products that fit differently.
- Hiding your returns policy near the helper.

## Who this is for

This suits fashion and footwear stores with fit related returns. It suits sellers of items where size matters but is rarely explained, such as bedding, furniture, bags or sports gear. It also suits a store owner who sees repeated messages asking "which size should I get?"

If you have no size chart yet, we can talk through what to measure first.

## What we need from you

Send your size charts, product measurements, a list of the product groups and examples of fit complaints. If you have return data, share the reasons.

We work in your own store, never need passwords and join as a collaborator or staff user. Removing our access later is always your choice. After you order, we send a short checklist and show a private preview before the helper goes live.
